name: shared-nav-marker
title: Shared navigation marker
description: Moves one measured marker between navigation destinations so hover, focus, and the current page share the same spatial cue.

accessibility.notes: Links remain ordinary links, the current destination uses aria-current, and focus is visible without relying on the moving marker.

performance.budget: Measures on focus, pointer entry, track scroll, and observed resize; the observer and scroll listener are removed on unmount.
